addon.name: Not Another WebShare Plugin
addon.provider-name: PetrSvarc; based on cache-sk YAWSP and community extensions

extension.description: A Kodi client for browsing, searching and playing files available through Webshare.cz. Forked from Yet Another Webshare Plugin (YAWSP).
extension.disclaimer: The plugin does not provide or host content. It acts as a client for Webshare. Users are responsible for the content they access.
Plugin neposkytuje ani nehostuje obsah. Funguje ako klient služby Webshare. Používateľ zodpovedá za obsah, ku ktorému pristupuje.
Plugin neposkytuje ani nehostuje obsah. Funguje jako klient služby Webshare. Uživatel odpovídá za obsah, ke kterému přistupuje.
extension.news:
[B]0.5.0[/B] - group equivalent movie and TV episode search results into version folders - rank versions deterministically using language, quality, codec and Webshare metadata - add preferred language/quality, HEVC and password-protected-file search preferences - show a user-facing Best match label while preserving the original Webshare filename - add Kodi-independent media parsing/ranking tests and package validation
[B]0.4.0[/B] - extracted Webshare HTTP/XML handling into a dedicated Python 3 API client - aligned login, search, queue and file-link requests with the current Webshare API reference - added network timeouts and explicit API/transport errors - removed Python 2 compatibility branches and the legacy Backup DB experiment - localized the series manager UI - added automated API-client tests and GitHub Actions validation
[B]0.3.0 NAWSP fork[/B] - renamed project and Kodi add-on identity to Not Another WebShare Plugin / plugin.video.nawsp - preserved YAWSP 0.3.0 Webshare functionality and series manager - updated source, provider and attribution metadata
